offering_description.value: Provides commercial and residential landscape maintenance, enhancement and irrigation services across the United States. Work is delivered by local branch crews using their own equipment and is sold under recurring maintenance contracts and one-time enhancement projects.

primary_products.value: landscape plants; mulch and soil; irrigation equipment

primary_services.value: landscape maintenance; landscape enhancement; irrigation services; tree care; snow and ice removal

customer_segment.value: B2B: commercial property owners, property managers, homeowners associations, multifamily operators; B2G: municipalities and government facilities

end_markets.value: commercial real estate; multifamily housing; healthcare campuses; education; retail

revenue_model.value: service fees: recurring maintenance contracts for grounds care; project or contract: enhancement, installation and irrigation projects billed per job

value_chain_position.value: service provider: performs landscape work on customer properties, sold to property owners and managers

geography_served.value: US national: nationwide across the United States through many local branches in numerous states

specialization.value: related lines: maintenance, enhancement, irrigation and tree care sharing the same commercial customers and crews

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales teams selling service contracts to property managers and owners; own locations: local branch offices serving nearby customer sites

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: state pesticide and fertilizer applicator licensing and environmental rules for chemical application
